title: Legatto channel promotion (legatto-promote/1)
description: Explicit promotion of one manifest to early or stable (D7(b)). Published as releases/<version>/promote/<channel>.json with signatures <file>.<signer-id>.sig from `ssh-keygen -Y sign -n legatto-promote`. Binds the exact manifest bytes and a green canary attestation. `promoted_at` is informational only: the server measures the minimum delay (policy.json) from the moment it first saw and verified this document.

sequence.description: Must equal `sequence` of the referenced manifest.

type.description: Must equal `type` of the referenced manifest; selects the delay row in policy.json.

manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact manifest.json bytes.

canary_attestation_sha256.description: sha256 of releases/<version>/attest/canary.json; that document must carry a valid canary signature and result PASS for this manifest.

early_promotion_sha256.description: channel=stable only: sha256 of promote/early.json of the same release, which must itself be valid.
